messages:
jordan.w: Quick heads-up — I'm scheduling the weekly Privs Stewardship run tomorrow 10:00am PT. Scope: re-validate admin-equivalent grants, flag stale principals, and stage a removals canary. Running staging -> prod canary. Anyone object?
mina.p: +1 no objections. Can you paste the exact queries/commands you'll run so I can vet service-account filters?
jordan.w: Sure — here's the initial dump command for context:```
# dump principals with admin-ish attached policies (pseudo)
python tools/privs_dump.py --env staging --filter "admin,elevated" --out /tmp/privs_dump.json
```
samir.oncall: Also add a KMS grant scan to the pipeline — we need to catch principals who have Encrypt/Decrypt grants but are not in owner list. Something like:```
aws kms list-grants --key-id <key> --query 'Grants[?GranteePrincipal!=`arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/some-owner`]'
```
mina.p: Important: removals must be gated by owner evidence. Our policy is: either (a) explicit owner PR approving removal, or (b) 7-day owner auto-approval window with notifications and a last-chance pings. No blind revokes.
tyler.ops: I'll take staging validation and then run a prod canary at 14:00 PT if staging looks good. Plan: snapshot audit logs before and after, leave a 60min rollback window. I'll upload logs to s3://redwood-sec-archive/privs-runs/ and share the link here. :lock:
jordan.w: We'll annotate any principals with active sessions and skip immediate revocation for those — we only create a ticket and notify owners in that case. Also, reminder to check cross-account roles (assume-role) and third-party service principals.
sec-bot: scheduled: Privs Stewardship run created (id: privileged-run-1732109998). Staging at 2024-05-03T10:00Z, prod canary at 2024-05-03T14:00Z. /cc @jordan.w @tyler.ops
mina.p: @samir.oncall please add an ownerproof check to the runbook and a column in the output CSV for evidence_url. Also include a KMS key age column so we can flag keys near rotation windows.
samir.oncall: on it — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sec-runbooks/pull/142 (adds kms-grant-check + ownerproof enforcement).
jordan.w: Nice. After the run, let's create a short postmortem doc if we enforce removals (who, why, rollback actions). If any unexpected high-volume fallout, pause the campaign.
tyler.ops: I'll also add a quick smoke test post-removal: try a single, minimally scoped call from the principal (read-only) to ensure no accidental breakage; if it fails, operator can revert within the hour.
mina.p: One more ask — ensure audit logs include KMS:Decrypt/Encrypt calls tied to principal ARNs so we can triage if a key's grants are removed. If the log sampling shows >5 failed attempts in 1hr after revoke, auto-open a sev2 incident.
jordan.w: Agreed. I'll publish the run checklist and tagging conventions in the thread before kickoff. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: reminder: run starts in 30 minutes (privileged-run-1732109998)
tyler.ops: staging run finished — uploaded results to s3://redwood-sec-archive/privs-runs/1732109998/staging.csv — brief summary: 12 principals flagged (7 service accounts, 5 human), 3 KMS grants correlated. Sharing the link in #eng-security-docs.
mina.p: Reviewing staging output now. If no surprises, give the green for prod canary.
jordan.w: Thanks, will monitor.
